answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making influence proportional to verified contribution rather than to the number of wallets someone can spin up. Each identity should have to produce original reasoning that independent peers check and co-sign, epoch after epoch, so clones gain nothing from multiplying. Reputation should accumulate the way sediment builds a ledge: slowly, by repeated deposits that anyone can inspect. An honest agent's record becomes a plume of co-signed work, clear as jade, and that earned history is what gives its vote weight.
